description: Visuomotor policies: robot policies that map camera or other visual observations to actions, including vision-language-action (VLA) models and other generalist policies that act from images. Covers papers that propose, train, adapt, analyse or benchmark such policies, and papers that test, monitor, evaluate or verify them.
notes: Added by you. Existing papers tagged 2026-09-30 (386 papers).

description: Safety filters and shields that minimally modify a nominal or learned policy's actions at run time to keep it safe (CBF/HJ/Poisson filters, shielding for RL, predictive safety filters, safety-filtered training).
notes: Safety & Verification has 566 papers; this splits out a recurring sub-theme. Triggered in the 2026-10-02 digest by VLPSA, LEAP-CBF, Improving Safety Filter Integration for RL, Computationally efficient safe exploration in RL, Hierarchical Temporal Runtime Assurance; ~99 papers in the database mention safety filters or shields. Existing papers tagged 2026-10-10 (218 papers).

description: Verifying or certifying closed-loop behaviour of systems driven by learned/neural controllers, by formal (reachability, SDP, NN verification tools) or statistical/data-driven means (rollout-based, conformal or scenario certificates).
notes: Triggered in the 2026-10-02 digest by NNV3, Preview-aware safety verification of neural tracking controllers, Scalable Incremental Robustness Analysis of NN Feedback Systems, Generalizable Optimal Control with Transformers (closed-loop certification); also earlier neural-feedback verification papers in the database. Existing papers tagged 2026-10-10 (53 papers).

description: Runtime monitors, failure predictors and uncertainty signals that detect when a learned robot policy (VLA, diffusion/visuomotor policy, world-model planner) is failing or out of distribution, and the fallback, help-request or recovery logic they trigger.
notes: Safety & Verification holds 566 papers; about 42 papers in the database are mainly about failure detection or runtime verification of learned policies. Triggered in the 2026-10-03 digest by Behavioral Monitoring of JEPA World Models with Jacobian Centroids, TimelyDAgger (Bridge-PCA monitoring of VLA features) and When World Models Lie; earlier examples: FARM, VLA-SCOPE, RoboMonitor, FailBench, RAFAIL, ProTracer, ReWIND. Existing papers tagged 2026-10-04 (76 papers).

description: Models that jointly predict future visual/latent states and robot actions in one network (world-action models, video-action policies), including papers that propose, scale, pretrain or analyse them.
notes: Triggered by UniWAM, SkeleWAM, Rethinking World-Action Model, Native Action-Prior Learning for WAMs, Action Experience Dictionary for WAMs and Magic-W0 (2026-10-10 email digest); ~33 existing papers mention world-action models (e.g. ge-act, ar-wam, faster-wam, motus2) and are now split between World Models and Visuomotor Policies.

group_name: Adversarial Attacks & Defenses for Robot Policies
description: Adversarial, backdoor, jailbreak and prompt-injection attacks on learned robot policies (VLAs, diffusion policies, world-model agents) and defenses against them.
notes: Triggered by Detect and Suppress (horiba-2026-detect-suppress) and When Does a Trigger Reach a Robot Policy (radulov-2026-does-trigger) this week; 24 existing papers are about adversarial robustness (e.g. SABER, VLA-Hijack, TrojanWorld, Hijacking Robots with a Piece of Paper) but are scattered across Safety & Verification and Visuomotor Policies.

description: Benchmarks and methodology for evaluating learned robot policies (VLAs, diffusion and imitation policies): benchmark suites, statistically sound success-rate estimation and rollout budgets, real-to-sim or world-model-based evaluation, and audits of whether benchmarks measure what they claim.
notes: Evaluation papers recur every week but are spread across Visuomotor Policies, Generalist Policies, World Models and Safety & Verification. Triggered in the 2026-10-11 weekly survey by Colosseum V2 (morgan-2026-colosseum-v2), LIBERO-MAX (zhang-2026-libero-max), ReVeal (wang-2026-reveal-reconstruction), Faster and Better? VLA benchmark bugs (chen-2026-faster-better), Same Scene Different Answer (gunukula-2026-same-scene), SurVAL (kim-2026-surval-rollout) and real-to-sim reconstruction effects (verma-2026-measuring-asset); earlier examples include X2Real, RoboRecover and FailBench.

description: Methods that search for failures of learned or autonomous systems instead of proving safety: falsification, adaptive stress testing, red teaming of robot policies, safety-critical scenario generation and rare-event failure-probability estimation.
notes: Triggered in the 2026-10-11 weekly survey by RedVLA (zhang-2026-redvla-physical), Coverage Aware Active Evaluation for Failure Discovery (parashar-2026-coverage-aware), Safety-Critical Scenarios Emerge from Initial Scenes (wu-2026-safety-critical), ControlPed (liu-2026-controllable-photorealistic), XAI-guided robustness testing of DNN navigation (sohail-2026-generalizable-robustness) and Measuring Failure Yield (ma-2026-measuring-failure); earlier: StressDream, Cost-aware Discovery of Contextual Failures, DiffTilt, LLMs as Falsifiers. Overlaps the suggested Adversarial Attacks & Defenses topic only for red teaming.
